neb11d453d2c.s: From 1 April 2022, the schemes of the Ministry of Women and Child Development are grouped under how many umbrella missions?
neb11d453d2c.x: Since 1 April 2022 MWCD schemes fall under three umbrella missions: Mission Shakti, Mission Vatsalya and Saksham Anganwadi & Poshan 2.0.

nindian-society-35-29.s: Which umbrella mission of the Ministry of Women and Child Development covers child protection, foster care and juvenile justice homes?
nindian-society-35-29.x: Mission Vatsalya covers child protection, foster care and juvenile justice homes. LPG connections in women's names come under Ujjwala.

nf9b31a75fea.s: Which is the nodal Ministry for Beti Bachao Beti Padhao?
o: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
nf9b31a75fea.x: BBBP is a joint scheme with MWCD as nodal ministry, along with Health and Family Welfare and Education; Social Justice and Empowerment is not involved.

n9988fe9e3fe.s: In which year was Beti Bachao Beti Padhao launched?
n9988fe9e3fe.x: BBBP was launched in 2015, initially in 100 gender-critical districts with a low Child Sex Ratio; 'since 2006' is wrong.

n1b086159051.s: Dhanalakshmi, a conditional cash transfer scheme for the girl child, was launched in:
n1b086159051.x: Dhanalakshmi (2008) linked cash to birth registration, immunisation, schooling and delaying marriage beyond 18.

nindian-society-35-30.s: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana improves women's health mainly by:
o: Giving LPG connections in women's names to end indoor smoke
Giving free antenatal check-ups every month
nindian-society-35-30.x: Ujjwala gives LPG connections in women's names, which ends indoor smoke from wood fires and so improves their health.

n8b9f1fd2014.s: Talliki Vandanam, the restructured form of Amma Vodi, gives eligible mothers how much a year?
n8b9f1fd2014.x: Talliki Vandanam gives ₹15,000 a year to eligible mothers, subject to 75 per cent attendance; ₹18,750 is YSR Cheyutha.

n7182f8e3533.s: Article 334 originally prescribed the reservation of seats for SCs and STs for how many years?
n7182f8e3533.x: Article 334 originally fixed a 10-year limit, later extended by amendments; it now runs to 2030, not 2035.

n9c0ddbfa109.s: Which Article requires SC/ST claims in services to be considered consistently with the efficiency of administration?
n9c0ddbfa109.x: Article 335 requires SC/ST claims to posts to be considered consistently with the maintenance of efficiency of administration.

n25e9f0ff1b2.s: Which reservation clause was added to the Constitution by the First Amendment, 1951?
n25e9f0ff1b2.x: Article 15(4) was the first reservation clause added by amendment (First Amendment, 1951); Article 16(4) was in the original Constitution.

n55f6a9a4995.s: The 131st Constitutional Amendment Bill (April 2026) sought to raise the strength of the Lok Sabha to:
n55f6a9a4995.x: The Bill sought to amend Articles 330, 332 and 334A and enlarge the Lok Sabha to 850; it was not passed.

n594119825a4.s: Which Amendment most recently extended SC/ST seat reservation under Article 334, up to 2030?
n594119825a4.x: The extensions came through the 8th, 23rd, 45th, 62nd, 79th, 95th and 104th Amendments; the 104th extended reservation to 2030.

n7145b46a2b5.s: Under which Article is the list of Scheduled Tribes for a State or Union Territory specified?
n7145b46a2b5.x: Article 342 deals with the specification of Scheduled Tribes; ST status is not restricted by religion.

n0f260b23dda.s: The Chairperson of the National Commission for Scheduled Tribes holds which rank?
n0f260b23dda.x: The NCST Chairperson has Cabinet rank, the Vice-Chairperson Minister of State rank, and members Secretary rank.

nc5fccf79a96.s: Land alienation, bonded labour, indebtedness and non-payment of wages are listed as causes of caste atrocities in reports of the:
o: National Commission for SCs and STs
nc5fccf79a96.x: Reports of the National Commission for SCs and STs list these causes; religious causes are not included.

n46df5a0ccb4.s: As per Census 2011, Scheduled Castes form what share of Andhra Pradesh's population?
n46df5a0ccb4.x: AP's SC population was 84.69 lakh, or 17.08%; 16.6% is the all-India share and 64.47% is SC literacy.

n45c080259f1.s: The Madiga Reservation Porata Samithi (MRPS) was founded in 1994 by:
n45c080259f1.x: Manda Krishna Madiga founded the MRPS in 1994, at Eedumudi in Prakasam district, not Karamchedu.

n5b2b3f94212.s: Which case struck down the AP Scheduled Caste (Rationalisation of Reservations) Act, 2000?
o: State of Punjab v. Davinder Singh
n5b2b3f94212.x: E.V. Chinnaiah treated SCs as a single class and held that sub-classification interfered with the Article 341 list.

n0fc849730c9.s: By what majority did the seven-judge Bench in State of Punjab v. Davinder Singh (2024) permit sub-classification within Scheduled Castes?
n0fc849730c9.x: The Bench permitted sub-classification by 6:1, overruling E.V. Chinnaiah.

nfcfd0842f49.s: NAMASTE is a joint initiative of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment and the Ministry of:
nfcfd0842f49.x: NAMASTE, aimed at zero sanitation deaths, is run jointly by MoSJE and the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.

nef19e51b46f.s: Under the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act and Rules, police investigation must ordinarily be completed within:
nef19e51b46f.x: The investigation is to be completed within 60 days; the Act dates from 1989 and the Rules from 1995.

n36e774472ab.s: In August 2026, what was the Centre's position on an income-based creamy layer in SC/ST reservations?
o: It left the decision to State SC Commissions
It said creamy-layer rules already apply to all SC/ST quotas
It opposed it, saying any change needs a holistic empirical review
n36e774472ab.x: The Centre's affidavit opposed an income-based creamy layer in SC/ST quotas and said any change needs a holistic empirical review.

n7c995db7519.s: Special Courts under the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act are set up in each district with the concurrence of the:
o: Chief Justice of the High Court
n7c995db7519.x: Special Courts are set up in each district with the concurrence of the High Court Chief Justice; Exclusive Special Courts came in 2015.

nbb7873832bf.s: Which of the following is NOT correctly matched under the SC and ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989?
o: Section 4 – Wilful neglect of duty by public servants
Section 19 – Appeal to the High Court within 90 days
Section 14A – Appeal to the High Court within 90 days
Section 23 – Rule-making power of the Central Government
nbb7873832bf.x: Section 19 bars probation for convicts; the 90-day appeal to the High Court is Section 14A.

na2ce821d945.s: In Prithvi Raj Chauhan v. Union of India, the Supreme Court held that courts may quash proceedings under the Atrocities Act only where:
o: The accused is a public servant
A DSP has made a preliminary enquiry
na2ce821d945.x: Chauhan upheld the 2018 amendment; relief or quashing is available only where no prima facie case exists.

n092f40c60ee.s: In Sukanya Shantha (2024), the Supreme Court held that Article 17 bars:
o: Only physical exclusion from public wells and temples
Only untouchability imposed by private employers
Only untouchability not followed by customary communities
n092f40c60ee.x: Sukanya Shantha held that Article 17 bars caste-based purity stigma, reading untouchability beyond physical exclusion.

nfbb36ce74e0.s: Under the SC and ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Rules, 1995, investigation must be by a police officer not below the rank of:
nfbb36ce74e0.x: Investigation is by an officer not below DSP rank, with the charge-sheet within 60 days.

n2e6b588caa0.s: In Balram Singh (2023), compensation for each sewer death was raised to:
n2e6b588caa0.x: Safai Karamchari Andolan (2014) ordered ₹10 lakh; Balram Singh (2023) raised it to ₹30 lakh.

n0e6b8e12648.s: The SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act principally covers offences against SCs/STs committed by:
o: Members of the same Scheduled Caste
n0e6b8e12648.x: The Act principally covers offences by non-SC/ST persons against SC/ST persons.

n34fe006bfc7.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the 2015 amendment to the Atrocities Act is correctly matched?
o: Exclusive Special Public Prosecutors – Part of the original 1989 Act
Special Court cognizance – Needs prior Central approval
Exclusive Special Courts – Inserted by the 2015 amendment
Direct cognizance by Special Courts – Barred
n34fe006bfc7.x: The 2015 amendment added Exclusive Special Courts and Exclusive Special PPs and let Special Courts take direct cognizance without prior approval.

nd818ccd1638.s: The Subhash Kashinath Mahajan directions of March 2018 were recalled on review in:
nd818ccd1638.x: The Mahajan directions were recalled on review in October 2019.

new.s: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao was launched on 22 January 2015 at:
new.x: BBBP was launched at Panipat (Haryana) on 22 January 2015. Ballia and Mahoba are the launch places of Ujjwala and Ujjwala 2.0.

new.s: How is Beti Bachao Beti Padhao funded?
new.x: BBBP is 100% centrally funded, with an initial outlay of ₹100 crore.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Beti Bachao Beti Padhao?
o: It falls under the Samarthya vertical of Mission Shakti
Its nodal ministry is Women and Child Development
new.x: BBBP falls under Sambal (safety), not Samarthya (empowerment), of Mission Shakti.

new.s: Before PMMVY 2.0, the ₹5,000 PMMVY benefit was paid in how many instalments?
new.x: The ₹5,000 was earlier paid in three instalments: ₹1,000 + ₹2,000 + ₹2,000.

new.s: Which group is excluded from PMMVY 2.0?
o: Mothers of a second girl child
new.x: PMMVY 2.0 excludes regular government employees; it gives ₹5,000 for the first child and ₹6,000 for a second child if a girl.

new.s: Which 2010 pilot maternity benefit scheme was the forerunner of PMMVY?
new.x: IGMSY (2010) was the pilot maternity benefit scheme that preceded PMMVY.

new.s: Janani Suraksha Yojana (2005) gives cash for:
new.x: JSY (2005), under the NHM and fully centrally funded, gives cash for institutional delivery.

new.s: The One Stop Centre (Sakhi) under Mission Shakti is funded from the:
new.x: One Stop Centres and Women Helpline 181 under Sambal are funded from the Nirbhaya Fund.

new.s: The Women Helpline under the Sambal sub-scheme of Mission Shakti is numbered:
new.x: Women Helpline 181 runs 24x7 and is being integrated with ERSS-112; 1098 is Childline.

new.s: Under Mission Vatsalya, Childline 1098 has been integrated with:
new.x: Mission Vatsalya integrates Childline 1098 with the emergency number 112.

new.s: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana is implemented by the Ministry of:
new.x: Ujjwala, launched on 1 May 2016 at Ballia, is a scheme of the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana?
o: It gives free LPG connections to BPL women
It was launched at Ballia in 2016
Ujjwala 2.0 gave a free first refill and hotplate
It is an anti-trafficking scheme of 2007
new.x: The 2007 anti-trafficking scheme is Ujjawala (now in Shakti Sadan); Ujjwala (2016) is the LPG scheme.

new.s: Stand-Up India is a scheme of which Ministry?
new.x: Stand-Up India (2016) is under the Ministry of Finance; DAY-NRLM is under Rural Development.

new.s: Stand-Up India gives loans of what range for greenfield enterprises?
new.x: Stand-Up India gives ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for new (greenfield) enterprises, not existing ones.

new.s: DAY-NRLM was launched in 2011 under the name:
new.x: DAY-NRLM began in 2011 as Aajeevika and was renamed in 2016.

new.s: Kishori Shakti Yojana (2000) provided adolescent girls with:
new.x: Kishori Shakti Yojana gave ICDS-based nutrition, health and life-skills to adolescent girls.

new.s: A Sukanya Samriddhi account can be opened for a girl below what age?
new.x: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (2015) is a small-savings account for a girl below 10, for her education and marriage.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the launch years of schemes:
1. Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana was launched in 2015.
2. Balika Samriddhi Yojana was launched in 1993.
3. Mahila Samriddhi Yojana was launched in 1993.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Sukanya is 2015 and Mahila Samriddhi 1993; Balika Samriddhi Yojana was launched in 1997, not 1993.

new.s: Swayam Siddha (2001) was a scheme for:
new.x: Swayam Siddha (2001) was an SHG-based holistic empowerment scheme; Ujjawala dealt with trafficking and Swadhar Greh with women in difficult circumstances.

new.s: Stree Shakti, the Andhra Pradesh scheme launched on 15 August 2025, provides:
o: Free APSRTC bus travel for women
new.x: Stree Shakti gives free APSRTC bus travel to girls, women and transgender persons with AP domicile.

new.s: YSR Cheyutha gives ₹18,750 a year to BC/SC/ST/minority women of which age group?
new.x: YSR Cheyutha (2020) gives ₹18,750 a year to BC/SC/ST/minority women aged 45-60.

new.s: Which of the following pairs of Andhra Pradesh schemes is correctly matched?
o: YSR Aasara – Free bus travel for women
Stree Shakti – ₹15,000 a year to mothers
YSR Cheyutha – Reimbursement of SHG loans
YSR Kalyanamasthu – Marriage aid for poor brides
new.x: Kalyanamasthu/Shaadi Tohfa gives marriage aid; Aasara reimburses SHG loans, Stree Shakti gives free bus travel, and ₹15,000 to mothers is Talliki Vandanam.

new.s: YSR Aasara reimburses SHG loans outstanding on which date?
new.x: YSR Aasara reimburses SHG loans outstanding on 11 April 2019, in four instalments.

new.s: The Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam reserves what share of Lok Sabha and State Assembly seats for women?
new.x: The 106th Amendment (Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam) reserves 33% of Lok Sabha and State Assembly seats for women.

new.s: The Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam was piloted by which Ministry?
new.x: The 106th Amendment came from the Ministry of Law and Justice.

new.s: Under the proviso to Article 164(1), which State is NOT required to have a Minister for Tribal Welfare?
new.x: The proviso covers Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh and Odisha; the 94th Amendment (2006) removed Bihar.

new.s: The 94th Amendment (2006) replaced Bihar in the Article 164(1) proviso with:
new.x: The 94th Amendment replaced Bihar with Chhattisgarh and Jharkhand in the list of States needing a Tribal Welfare Minister.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the proviso to Article 164(1):
1. The Tribal Welfare Minister may also hold charge of SC and BC welfare.
2. Odisha and Madhya Pradesh are among the States covered.
3. The 94th Amendment added Bihar to the list.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; the 94th Amendment (2006) removed Bihar, replacing it with Chhattisgarh and Jharkhand.

new.s: Which Directive Principle Article directs the State to promote the educational and economic interests of SCs and STs?
new.x: Article 46 (DPSP) covers the educational and economic interests of SCs/STs and their protection from social injustice.

new.s: Grants-in-aid from the Consolidated Fund of India for the welfare of Scheduled Tribes are provided under Article:
new.x: Article 275(1) provides grants-in-aid from the CFI for ST welfare; Article 339 gives the Union control of Scheduled Areas.

new.s: Union control over the administration of Scheduled Areas is provided under Article:
new.x: Article 339 deals with Union control of Scheduled Areas and the Commission on Scheduled Areas.

new.s: How many of Andhra Pradesh's 175 Assembly seats are reserved for Scheduled Castes?
new.x: The AP Assembly has 29 SC and 7 ST seats out of 175.

new.s: How many of Andhra Pradesh's 25 Lok Sabha seats are reserved for Scheduled Castes?
new.x: AP has 4 SC seats and 1 ST seat (Araku) among its 25 Lok Sabha seats.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about reserved seats for SCs and STs?
o: Seats are reserved in proportion to population
Seats are reserved in the Rajya Sabha too
new.x: Articles 330 and 332 reserve seats only in the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies; there are no SC/ST seats in the Rajya Sabha.

new.s: Besides extending SC/ST seat reservation to 2030, the 104th Amendment (2019):
new.x: The 104th Amendment ended Anglo-Indian nomination; women's reservation (334A) is the 106th.

new.s: Which Amendment extended SC/ST seat reservation in legislatures up to 2020?
new.x: The 95th Amendment (2009) extended the reservation to 2020; the 104th took it to 2030.

new.s: As per Census 2011, how many caste groups are notified as Scheduled Castes?
new.x: 1,241 caste groups were notified as Scheduled Castes as per Census 2011.

new.s: The first post-1950 list of Scheduled Castes was issued as the:
new.x: The first list after 1950 was the Constitution (SC) Order, 1950; the first list was of 1936 under the GoI Act 1935.

new.s: Where is 'untouchability' defined?
o: It is not defined in the Constitution or any Act
new.x: Untouchability is not defined in the Constitution or any Act; the Mysore HC read it as the practice as historically developed.

new.s: Which case held that Article 17 binds private persons too?
new.x: Article 17 applies horizontally to private persons, as held in PUDR v. Union of India (1982).

new.s: The term 'Scheduled Castes' was first used by the:
new.x: The term was first used by the Simon Commission and given shape in the Government of India Act, 1935.

new.s: The Andhra Pradesh Devadasis (Prohibition of Dedication) Act, 1989 provides for the rehabilitation of:
new.x: The AP Devadasis Act 1989 is for the rehabilitation of Jogin women.

new.s: The Prohibition of Employment as Manual Scavengers and their Rehabilitation Act, 2013 came into force on:
new.x: The 2013 Act came into force on 6 December 2013.

new.s: As of August 2026, about how many manual scavengers had been identified in India?
new.x: About 58,000 manual scavengers were identified; 90,915 is the sewer/septic workers profiled and 2,652 the projects approved.

new.s: Which case held that no data on backwardness is needed for SC/ST reservation in promotion and that the creamy layer applies?
new.x: Jarnail Singh (2018) dropped the need for backwardness data for SC/ST promotion and applied the creamy layer.

new.s: Which case limited Article 16(4) to initial appointment and set a 50% ceiling on reservation?
new.x: Indra Sawhney (1992) held that 16(4) applies only at initial appointment and fixed the 50% ceiling.

new.s: Besides the Chairperson and Vice-Chairperson, how many members does the National Commission for Scheduled Castes have?
new.x: Each Commission has a Chairperson, a Vice-Chairperson and 3 members; the President fixes their tenure.

new.s: From which date did the separate National Commission for Scheduled Tribes come into being?
new.x: After the 89th Amendment (2003) split the joint commission, the NCST came into being on 19 February 2004.

new.s: In which year did the joint commission for SCs and STs become a constitutional body?
new.x: A non-statutory Commission came in 1978; it became a constitutional joint commission in 1990 and was split in 2003.

new.s: The Harijan Sevak Sangh was founded in 1932 by:
new.x: Gandhi founded the Harijan Sevak Sangh in 1932 after the Poona Pact; Bhagya Reddy Varma called it paternalistic.

new.s: The Kalaram Temple Entry Satyagraha (1930) led by Ambedkar took place at:
new.x: The Kalaram Temple Entry Satyagraha was at Nashik in 1930; Mahad (1927) was about water from a public tank.

new.s: Gulamgiri (1873) was written by:
new.x: Gulamgiri (slavery) is by Jyotiba Phule; Annihilation of Caste is Ambedkar's and Gabbilam is Jashuva's.

new.s: Who held that political freedom is meaningless without social equality?
new.x: Periyar stressed self-respect and held political freedom meaningless without social equality.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (Leader – Statement or idea) is correctly matched?
o: Ambedkar – Untouchability is a blot on Hinduism
Periyar – I was born a Hindu, but I will not die a Hindu
Gandhi – Caste is a division of labourers
new.x: Gandhi coined 'Harijan' and called untouchability a blot on Hinduism; the Yeola declaration and 'division of labourers' are Ambedkar's.

new.s: As per NCRB data for 2023, which State recorded the most crimes against Scheduled Castes?
new.x: Uttar Pradesh (15,130) led, followed by Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh, out of 57,789 cases.

new.s: As per Census 2011, Scheduled Castes form what share of India's population?
new.x: SCs in India number 20.14 crore, or 16.6%; 17.08% is AP's share.

new.s: Which State has the highest share of Scheduled Castes in its population (Census 2011)?
new.x: Punjab has the highest SC share of population.

new.s: The Untouchability (Offences) Act, 1955 was renamed the Protection of Civil Rights Act in:
new.x: The Act was renamed in 1976; the PCR Rules came in 1977.

new.s: The SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act has applied to Jammu and Kashmir since:
new.x: The PoA Act applies to J&K since 2019.

new.s: The Protection of Civil Rights Rules were framed in:
new.x: The PCR Rules date from 1977; the PoA Rules from 1995.

new.s: Under which Section of the Protection of Civil Rights Act is preaching or justifying untouchability punishable?
new.x: Section 7 covers insulting an SC member and preaching or justifying untouchability.

new.s: Section 15A of the Protection of Civil Rights Act deals with:
new.x: Section 15A lists State duties: legal aid, special courts, surveys of prone areas, vigilance officers and annual reports.

new.s: Special Public Prosecutors under the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act are provided under Section:
new.x: Section 15 provides Special Public Prosecutors; Section 14 provides Special Courts.

new.s: Under the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, the collective fine is imposed and collected by the:
new.x: Section 16 empowers the State Government; a Special Court cannot impose a collective fine.

new.s: The State Vigilance and Monitoring Committee under the PoA Rules, 1995 is headed by the:
new.x: The State committee is headed by the Chief Minister; the District committee by the Collector.

new.s: Under Rule 17 of the PoA Rules, 1995, the District Vigilance and Monitoring Committee is headed by the:
new.x: Rule 17 sets up a District Vigilance and Monitoring Committee in each district, headed by the Collector/DM.

new.s: Relief to atrocity victims under the PoA Rules (2016) ranges from:
new.x: Since 2016 relief ranges from ₹85,000 to ₹8.25 lakh.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 2015 amendment to the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act?
o: Dedicating a woman as a devadasi was made an atrocity
Special Courts may take direct cognizance
Trial is to be completed within 90 days of the charge-sheet
new.x: The 2015 amendment set the trial to be completed within 60 days of the charge-sheet, not 90.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the 2015 amendment to the Atrocities Act:
1. Abusing by caste name was made an atrocity.
2. Garlanding with footwear was made an atrocity.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are among the new atrocities added in 2015, along with tonsuring, witchcraft accusations and forced manual scavenging.

new.s: The 2018 amendment to the Atrocities Act, responding to the Mahajan judgment, inserted Section:
new.x: The 2018 Amendment Act inserted Section 18A (no preliminary enquiry or approval before arrest), not Section 4A.

new.s: In Subhash Kashinath Mahajan (2018), the Supreme Court required a preliminary enquiry before registering an FIR by an officer of which rank?
new.x: Mahajan required a preliminary enquiry by a DSP, a direction later recalled; Section 18A now bars it.

new.s: Under the 2013 Manual Scavengers Act, the penalty for a first breach is up to:
new.x: A first breach attracts 1 year / ₹50,000; hazardous sewer cleaning 2 years / ₹2 lakh.

new.s: The conviction rate under the PoA Act in 2022 was about:
new.x: The PoA conviction rate fell to about 32-33% in 2022 from 39-40% in 2020, with pendency near 97%.

new.s: Which State recorded the most crimes against Scheduled Castes in 2023?
new.x: Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh were the top States in 2023.

new.s: Which district had the most atrocity-prone villages in Andhra Pradesh as per the MHA list of July 2022?
new.x: Of AP's 53 atrocity-prone villages, East Godavari had 47, Kadapa 5 and Srikakulam 1.

new.s: Besides one Exclusive Court, how many Special Sessions Courts does Andhra Pradesh have for SC/ST atrocity cases?
new.x: AP has 14 Special Sessions Courts and 1 Exclusive Court at Laxmipet, Srikakulam.
